compressed_kv.persistent_authority: semantic BF16/dequantized tensor after in-place FP4 quantization
compressed_kv.reason: official cache stores the mutated/dequantized latent tensor, not returned FP4 bytes/scales
compressed_kv.sequence: latent = compressor(...); apply_rotary_emb(latent); fp4_act_quant(latent, 16, True, scale_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn); self.compress_kv_cache[...] = latent; later reads shared_attn.compress_kv cache slice

index_k.persistent_authority: semantic BF16/dequantized tensor after in-place FP4 quantization
index_k.reason: official cache stores the mutated/dequantized k tensor, not returned FP4 bytes/scales
index_k.sequence: k = k_norm(wk(latent)); apply_rotary_emb(k); fp4_act_quant(k, fp4_block_size, True); self.k_cache[...] = k; shared_attn.index_k = self.k_cache

fp4_act_quant.doc: inplace=True writes the dequantized values back to x

window_kv_reference: same pattern was already established for act_quant(..., inplace=True) in Attention._window_kv
